arabic_html:
لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ
لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ
رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ
arabic_html_2:
رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًۭا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ
رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ
وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ
أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ ۞
hook:
When it all feels
like too much.
translation: Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. It gets what it earns, and it bears what it earns. Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or err. Our Lord, do not lay on us a burden like that which You laid on those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we cannot bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people.
translation_vo: Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. It gets what it earns, and it bears what it earns. Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not lay on us a burden like that which You laid on those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people.
explanation_html: It opens in mercy — Allah asks no soul beyond its capacity (Ibn Kathīr). What follows is a duʿāʾ Allah Himself taught, revealed while promising to answer it. And these closing verses of Al-Baqarah are a gift, the hadith says, given to no prophet before.
explanation_vo: It opens in mercy. Allah asks no soul beyond its capacity. What follows is a prayer Allah Himself taught, revealed while promising to answer it. And these closing verses of the Cow are a gift, the hadith says, given to no prophet before.
